## History

Carlo was an old dog who originally belonged to [Dick Moore](../character/dick.md) for about a year before [Dick](../character/dick.md) married [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md). When [Dick](../character/dick.md) sailed on the [Four Sisters](../codex/tech.md#four-sisters), he left Carlo behind with [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md), and the dog became deeply devoted to her, helping her endure her first lonely year after her mother's death. Carlo eventually passed away, leaving [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) to mourn the loss of her faithful companion.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 28 ODDS AND ENDS P0](../source/v04-c28.md#nw-v04-c28-p0000), [v4 CHAPTER 28 ODDS AND ENDS P2](../source/v04-c28.md#nw-v04-c28-p0002), [v4 CHAPTER 28 ODDS AND ENDS P7](../source/v04-c28.md#nw-v04-c28-p0007), [v4 CHAPTER 28 ODDS AND ENDS P9](../source/v04-c28.md#nw-v04-c28-p0009), [v4 CHAPTER 28 ODDS AND ENDS P10](../source/v04-c28.md#nw-v04-c28-p0010), [v4 CHAPTER 28 ODDS AND ENDS P11](../source/v04-c28.md#nw-v04-c28-p0011), +24 more_

## Relationships

### [Leslie Moore](../character/leslie-moore.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/carlo--leslie-moore.md)

Carlo was [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) Moore's faithful dog companion, providing her with comfort during her difficult life in [Four Winds](../codex/places.md#four-winds). Following his death, [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) deeply mourned his loss, a grief that was acknowledged by her neighbors when discussing her recent life changes.
